title: Modified MAGIC model to assess and predict acidification effects on water chemistry changes in Taihu lake, China
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3286-3296
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00081E, Paper
Taoran Shi, Xiaoke Zhuo, Gaoying Xu, Jinbiao Ma, Juntao Fan, Tao Yu
The MAGIC model has been adaptively calibrated to comprehensively and effectively assess the water chemistry changes impacted by human disturbances in the Taihu watershed, in order to achieve a better effect in watershed management practice.
